terra.problem: The passage does not say John has had a lot of practice saying no or that he is answering more quickly.
Saying John is not unsure assigns him a feeling the text does not give.
The claim that Isaiah lived long before John's day needs a reference outside this passage.
The builder comparison is generic and adds little personality or explanation.
The farmer comparison is generic and adds little personality or explanation.
The text does not place this One in a crowd or say the visitors walked past Him.
The claim that people stand back rather than line up beside someone adds an action the passage does not describe.
Saying John is the one pulling back the curtain assigns him the act of revealing Jesus. John says he came baptizing so Jesus might be revealed, without saying that John reveals Him.
The explanation is a flat restatement of the answer and verse, with no distinct Papa Dorin voice.
The passage does not say John spoke for everyone to hear.
The explanation simply repeats the title without adding a distinct voice or useful explanation.
